changes: Tool-union diagnostics retain the requested action/checker operation, then use other scalar discriminators and permitted property names to choose a relevant error.
Diagnostic matching distinguishes JSON booleans from numbers and leaves structured enum values outside scalar scoring. Validation and tool authorization are unchanged.
Public API catalog downloads and cached snapshots reject unquoted NaN, Infinity and -Infinity before accepting or replacing a valid catalog. Quoted words remain ordinary strings.

validation.baseline_failures: Seven initial union-diagnostic failures and the donated catalog regressions reproduced before their fixes. Four additional diagnostic counterexamples caught an intermediate operation-priority/structured-enum regression before publication.

limits: This changes error explanations, not which arguments are authorized or whether a whole project is correct.
No end-to-end autonomous app success is claimed. The separate expense-app continuation remains incomplete at four of eight original steps, including failed reload persistence.
Experimental combined-field authoring and its request-local tool schema are not part of this public release; the public backend does not yet implement that API.
Existing Python migration, automatic engine-orphan recovery and other unfinished work remain separate.
